title: XPS AutoFit Studio
description: Automated, reproducible X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy (XPS) peak fitting: physics-constrained model selection (AICc/BIC among models that pass spin-orbit, width and separation checks), static and active Shirley/Tougaard backgrounds, Voigt and Doniach-Šunjić line shapes, robust loss and spike masking, bootstrap uncertainties propagated to compositions, survey element identification, batch processing, a desktop application and a JSON project file that reproduces every number.
